 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma
 Order

By way of the instant petition, the petitioner seeks direction to the respondent to transfer petitioner in Semi-Open Prison in case arising out of FIR bearing No.181/2012, registered at Police Station GTB Enclave, Delhi for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 302/498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC').
2. Issue notice.
The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State and seeks time to file the Status Report.

Let the same be filed, at least two days prior to the next date of hearing, with an advance copy to the other side.
3. Nominal roll of the applicant be also called, from the concerned Jail Superintendent, before the next date of hearing.
4. List on 25.02.2026.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/12/2025 at 21:18:21 5.
The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
